transformations.accuracy_latent_point: inverse_logit(predicted accuracy level); do not add observation noise
transformations.speed_latent_point: exp(predicted log-seconds level); this is the conditional median

forecast_accuracy_variance.rule: For a future quiz with n items and latent probability p, add 1/(n*p + 0.5) + 1/(n*(1-p) + 0.5) to the accuracy observation variance. For filtering an observed attempt, use the actual correct and incorrect counts instead.

prediction_contract.point_estimates: Use the posterior distribution of latent levels. Accuracy is the inverse-logit of the accuracy level; speed is exp(log-seconds level).
prediction_contract.predictive_intervals: Add state, process, observation, and item-count accuracy variance. Intervals describe performance on the next attempt, not uncertainty about a fixed regression line.
prediction_contract.goal_probability: Calculate jointly from predictive accuracy and speed draws. Require accuracy >= 0.90 and the response-mode fluency target.
prediction_contract.gap_requirement: Forecasts are conditional on an explicit assumed next-attempt gap. Use 0 days only for a same-day scenario; do not call it gap-neutral.

validation_notes.model_selection: Damped trend was the provisional chronological-screening winner; local trend remained within roughly 1.1 clustered SE.
validation_notes.typed_mode: Typed data are sparse. Typed forecasts remain more strongly pooled and should be presented cautiously.
validation_notes.zero_history: Options cold-start 80% coverage was below nominal in the full-data posterior check. Treat zero-history output as a benchmark rather than a personalised forecast.
validation_notes.observation_correlation: The observation correlation uses an unrestricted Fisher-style parameterisation via tanh(raw correlation). The previous hard lower bound of -0.8 was removed after sensitivity analysis showed substantial posterior mass below that boundary.
validation_notes.accuracy_display: Display latent accuracy for the point estimate. Observation noise is used for predictive intervals and goal probabilities, not for the displayed central accuracy estimate.
